"Your fate has already been written."

waiter bring me more roblox asym SLUDGE inspired by forstinken!!!!

One Evil Antagonist, against a team of 8 Protagonists. Teamwork is crucial, never leave a teammate alone.

Our cast of characters mainly revolves around characters that could be from quite literally anywhere. We have no theme and we don't want to revolve around one thing. Basically just the hypothetical of: "What if we put ___ into Forsaken?"

**⚠️ HEAVILY INSPIRED ⚠️** BY: Forsaken, Pillar Chase 2, Dead by Daylight, Die of Death (WE LOVE YOU DOD)

Crimson Chronicles [ALPHA] 
Note: ALOT of gameplay is SUBJECT/GOING to change in the future. Most of what you see might be reworked, especially maps. Gameplay is somewhat barebones right now and will be have major additions in the future.

If you're wondering why we have so little statistics, it's because we had to switch places due to Roblox's great moderation team being very efficient in reviewing games.
